unified_features.name: Accounts and sign-in
unified_features.rationale: A and B both had email and password sign-in (identical); A's cookie-session version is kept, B's token version dropped (M02).
unified_features.behaviour: Email and password accounts, PBKDF2 hashes, an http-only session cookie that ends after 30 idle minutes.

unified_features.name: Unified roles and permissions
unified_features.rationale: A (owner/member) and B (requester/approver/admin) model access differently; combined into one role set rather than keeping two.
unified_features.behaviour: Roles owner, admin and member, plus an approve permission; one function answers every permission question.
unified_features.improvements: Approving becomes a permission instead of a role, so a member can approve without becoming an admin.

unified_features.name: Notification engine
unified_features.rationale: In-app (A), email (B) and push (C) are channels of one capability; one engine avoids three notification systems.
unified_features.behaviour: Every event creates one in-app notification; email and push deliveries are queued according to each user's preferences; a dedupe key stops double sends.

unified_features.name: Task board
unified_features.behaviour: Create tasks and move them between todo, doing and done; only the creator, assignee, owners and admins may move a task.

unified_features.name: Task assignment
unified_features.rationale: Only A has it; kept separate from the board because it has its own permission and notification rules.
unified_features.behaviour: Assign a task to a person; the assignee is notified once on every channel they chose; assigning yourself notifies nobody.

unified_features.name: Threaded comments
unified_features.rationale: A's flat comments (M06) and B's threaded comments were alternatives; B's kept, A's dropped.
unified_features.behaviour: Comments with replies on tasks and on approvals; a reply's parent author is notified.
unified_features.improvements: Works on tasks as well as approvals (B only had requests).

unified_features.name: Approval requests
unified_features.rationale: Only B has it; attached to tasks in the unified app.
unified_features.behaviour: Ask for sign-off on a task; approvers are notified; only someone with the approve permission decides, never on their own request; a task with a pending approval cannot be closed.

unified_features.name: Workload dashboard
unified_features.rationale: Only C (closed) has it; rebuilt from its public description.
unified_features.behaviour: Open tasks per person, overdue open tasks (by UTC date) and pending approvals.
